children.text: Each row = one concept, 5 key frames left -> right with timing and animation/SFX notes. Pick one (or mix), then I build it in code.
children.name: Sub

children.text: The higher the roll, the longer and louder the build-up. Players learn the colour ladder, so a purple flash = heart rate up.
children.name: Desc

children.text: +black-out then rainbow, screen shake, SERVER-WIDE toast 'X rolled Dragon Emperor!'
children.name: Rule

children.text: Retention extras: Mythic pity counter (shown on the altar) • x10 = 10% discount • SKIP after first view • Auto-roll until Epic+ • 'NEW!' for first-time auras
children.name: Extras

children.text: Orb on an altar charges, cracks, leaks light in the rolled rarity's colour, then bursts. Classic, clear, works for x1 and x10 (x10 = 10 small orbs crack in a row).
children.name: Desc

children.text: Mystery orb floats on the altar (bob 4px, 2s loop). Pity pill shows progress to a guaranteed Mythic. ROLL x1 / x10.
children.name: Notes

children.text: Screen dims, orb scales 1.0 -> 1.4 with ease-in, shakes harder each 0.2s. SFX: rising hum. Mobile: light haptic ticks.
children.name: Notes

Concept B — Reel Slot  (CHOSEN, in code: UI/AuraReel)

children.text: B. Reel Slot  (CHOSEN, in code: UI/AuraReel)
children.name: Title

children.text: A slot-machine reel of aura orbs, pulled like a fishing reel. Speed blur, slows down, near-misses on rarer orbs, then locks. Strong 'one more spin' pull.
children.name: Desc

children.text: Reel shows 3 orbs. Pressing ROLL 'casts' the rod lever; the reel jerks up first (anticipation 0.15s).
children.name: Notes

children.text: Reel spins fast (motion blur via faded copies). SFX: reel clicking, tick rate follows speed.
children.name: Notes
